ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Government Fraud
ideas.description: Investigation into government agencies and programs to identify potential fraud and corruption
ideas.angle: Data analysis and public records review
questions: What government agencies are most susceptible to fraud?
How can data analysis be used to identify potential corruption?
ideas.insight: By analyzing data and reviewing public records, we can identify patterns and connections that may indicate fraud or corruption within government agencies. This investigation could lead to a deeper understanding of the scope of the problem and potential solutions.
